items.title: Mine, Sample, Render: Test-Time Diversity Alignment Of Generative Models
items.summary: MSR improves generative diversity by mining categorical schemas from real artifacts to guide conditional rendering at test time.

items.title: Behavioral Compositionality of Sparse Autoencoder Representations
items.summary: Sparse autoencoder features are partially compositional but require interaction terms for accurate behavioral predictions and steering.

items.title: Diminishing Returns of Data in Sparse Autoencoders: Functional Behavior does not Guarantee Feature Reproducibility
items.summary: Sparse autoencoders can be trained with far fewer activation tokens when data budgets align with evaluation goals, though feature-level reproducibility demands larger scales.

items.title: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: LEASH is a training-free framework that uses latent uncertainty to escalate from a weak to a strong computer-use agent only when needed and monitors the strong agent afterward, reducing cost while maintaining high success.

items.title: Scalable Weak-to-Strong Verifier Hardening for Agent Environments
items.summary: The study proposes an automated weak-to-strong loop that hardens agent environment verifiers against reward hacking by iteratively finding and repairing vulnerabilities in isolated sandboxes.

items.title: LeanPRM: Lean-Grounded Process Supervision for Natural Language Proof Verification
items.summary: LeanPRM uses the Lean proof assistant to automatically generate step-level correctness labels for natural-language mathematical proofs, enabling scalable training of learned verifiers without human annotation.

items.title: Equal CER, Unequal Damage: Severity-Weighted Character Error Rate for OCR
items.summary: A new metric called semCER uses an LLM judge to weight grapheme edits by severity, improving alignment with human ratings over standard character error rate for OCR and vision-language models.

items.title: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories
items.summary: PathFM is a trajectory-based forecasting model using flow matching to generate complete future paths, enabling efficient multi-path sampling and improved dependence modeling for time series.

items.title: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
items.summary: Hidden states encode task information before the readout expresses it, so behavioral timelines reflect readout learning rather than model acquisition, and faster readout training closes this gap earlier.

items.title: Copy-Paste Language Models
items.summary: Copy-Paste Language Models enhance in-context copying by adding a lightweight head that improves training efficiency, downstream performance, and long-context retrieval with minimal overhead.

items.title: Explaining the Roles of Experts in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs for Personalization
items.summary: Personalizing sparse Mixture-of-Experts language models enables localized, interpretable control over user-specific behaviors through specialized expert routing and learned personalized latents.

items.title: PAIR: Bridging Perception and Action in Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: PAIR introduces a shared perception-action representation via masked action autoencoders and bridge tokens to improve continuous-action vision-language-action models.

items.title: Beyond Policy Rollouts: Embedding-Space Directional Exploration with Anchored Noise for LLM RLVR
items.summary: EDEN improves reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards by injecting anchored embedding noise into rollout conditioning to increase diversity and strengthen group-relative advantage signals without altering inference.

items.title: One Bias Score, Two Factors: How Mitigations Affect Option Bias in Multiple-Choice Evaluation
items.summary: Selection bias and order sensitivity in multiple-choice models are decomposed into flip rate and positional skew via pooled standard deviation, showing that prior correction and aggregation target different factors and should be reported together with accuracy.

items.title: Gen4P: Video Generators are 4D Perceivers
items.summary: Gen4P repurposes a pretrained video generator into a feed-forward 4D perceiver that predicts geometry and motion from monocular video via on-demand cross-attention decoding and frozen depth priors.

items.title: When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU: Scaling Remote KV Tiers for Context-Parallel Prefill
items.summary: Remote KV caching for long-context LLM serving can severely degrade latency unless the store is sharded by parallel rank, loaded asynchronously, and paired with high-bandwidth retrieval, yielding large throughput gains.

items.title: Virtual Head Attention
items.summary: Virtual Head Attention improves long-context model efficiency by reducing KV cache and compute while preserving quality through lightweight linear query and output transformations.

items.title: Speech event detector: Timestamped detection of non-verbal vocalizations and background sounds for rich speech transcription
items.summary: A convolutional-Transformer model detects 54 speech and background event classes with timestamped outputs merged into transcripts, trained on unified multi-source annotations with synthetic augmentation.

items.title: FlashMask-3: Efficient and Expressive Mask-Aware Distributed Attention
items.summary: FlashMask-3 accelerates long-context attention via a Hopper-optimized sparse-mask kernel and distributed context-parallel extensions that eliminate mask-communication overhead and improve training throughput.

items.title: SUPRA-TEX: 3D Generation with Super-Aligned Texture
items.summary: SUPRA-Tex decouples visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and 3D completion to generate relightable 3D materials that preserve reference image details and complete unobserved surfaces.

items.title: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
items.summary: OneWM unifies causal training of world and action modeling, showing that learning action-conditioned dynamics improves policies and action learning improves multi-view world prediction.

items.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
items.summary: FDE-Gym evaluates AI agents on realistic customer delivery tasks requiring clarification of ambiguous requirements and discovery of unstated constraints, revealing a substantial performance gap compared to well-specified benchmarks.

items.title: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Patch-wise Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
items.summary: A framework dynamically assigns denoising steps to video patches based on difficulty, cutting computation by half while preserving quality.

items.title: Data World: Scaling Data Environments from Scratch
items.summary: A multi-agent engine synthesizes data environments and tasks to train models for analytical insight discovery, improving performance across benchmarks without trajectory distillation.

items.title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
items.summary: A graded visual verifier decomposes complex multimodal rules into pointwise scores and uses decoupled reinforcement learning to improve generalization, with pairwise verification further enhancing structured world-modeling accuracy.

items.title: MAI-Gym: An Open All-in-One Platform for GUI Agent Evaluation and RL Training across Mobile and Computer Environments
items.summary: MAI-Gym is an open platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online reinforcement learning training across mobile, computer, and web environments, enabling scalable synthesis of verified tasks and training of a unified 9B agent with state-of-the-art open performance.

items.title: SERO: Learning from Executable Oracle Continuations for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: SERO improves long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning by training on executable oracle continuations from real policy states, weighted by policy compatibility, without inference-time overhead.

items.title: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
items.summary: SimForcing improves action-conditioned robot world models by distilling motion knowledge from simulation and using controllable simulation conditioning to generate realistic videos across robot datasets.

items.title: CoWorld Reasoner: Agentic Multimodal Reasoning with the Evolving Video World Model-Driven Harness
items.summary: CoWorld Reasoner is an agentic framework that uses a video world model as a flexible visual reasoning engine, enabling vision-language models to perform diverse spatiotemporal reasoning through guided visual imagination and co-evolving tools.

items.title: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
items.summary: OpenGCUA introduces an open generalist computer-use agent that integrates visual and programmatic interfaces, harness-to-model decision transfer, and code execution to improve task performance and efficiency across models.

items.title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
items.summary: CoDA co-evolves a simulation engine and robot policy via shared memory of failures and progress, using vision-language diagnostics and staged potential rewards to improve out-of-distribution manipulation success.

items.title: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching
items.summary: MJev-Spatial is a fast multimodal decision model that unifies spatial reasoning tasks into a single-pass classification framework, improving speed and accuracy over autoregressive vision-language models.

items.title: VLA-Δ: Learning Physical State Transition for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: VLA-Δ improves robot control by explicitly supervising physical state transitions between current and future observations, achieving strong benchmark and real-world results without added inference cost.

items.title: Cowork-Gym: Synthesizing Interactive Work Environments at Scale
items.summary: Cowork-Gym synthesizes collaborative agent environments via iterative validation and trains Qwen models that substantially improve agentic benchmark performance.

items.title: H-DDCM: Hadamard Codebooks for Fast Generative Image and Video Compression
items.summary: H-DDCM replaces dense Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries and table-free lexicographic coding to enable scalable, efficient generative image and video compression using diffusion and flow models.

items.title: AI-Driven, Timing-Aware Power Optimization
items.summary: An AI-driven framework uses learned ranking and deterministic EDA analysis to recover post-route power while controlling repair costs and preserving timing, electrical, and physical constraints.

items.title: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: Waypoint-OPD improves policy-shift distillation by gating endpoint shifts using directional agreement between early and late teacher policy changes, boosting reasoning performance with minimal overhead.

items.title: MMSearch-OPD: Easy Made Hard, Hard Made Learnable for Long-Horizon Multimodal Search Agents
items.summary: MMSearch-OPD improves long-horizon multimodal search by refining reasoning data and jointly training with reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation.

items.title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
items.summary: A post-training framework using hierarchical supervised fine-tuning and windowed interaction reinforcement learning trains a 35B mixture-of-experts agent to autonomously optimize long-horizon machine learning engineering workflows.

items.title: PINT: A Unified Model with Shared Predictive Intent for Robot Manipulation
items.summary: PINT unifies vision-language reasoning, video world modeling, and action generation via learnable predictive intent tokens to improve robot manipulation generalization without embodied pretraining.

items.title: Each Reward to Its Relevant Tokens: Reward-Specific Token-Level Credit Assignment for Multi-Reward RL
items.summary: MRTPO improves multi-reward training by assigning each reward's advantage only to relevant tokens via replay-based relevance measurement, accelerating convergence and boosting performance.

items.title: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
items.summary: Market-based post-training jointly learns decentralized agent policies and self-orchestration via bidding, improving coordination, scalability, and robustness across embodied and research tasks.

items.title: Recursive Environment Scaling for General Long-Horizon Agents
items.summary: Recursive Environment Scaling transforms benchmarks to increase difficulty while preserving objectives, improving both agent evaluation and supervised fine-tuning performance.

items.title: WorldCast: Exploring Intelligent Visual Generation in World State Prediction
items.summary: Researchers propose a four-level hierarchy for multimodal generative models and introduce the WorldCast benchmark to evaluate multi-step world state prediction, revealing rapid progress by frontier systems but substantial gaps in open-source models for reasoning-heavy visual forecasting.

items.title: Mosaic: Multi-Session Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Multi-session agentic reinforcement learning is introduced to handle trajectories across multiple sessions, with Mosaic optimizing session-level contributions and allocation via hierarchical advantage estimation.

items.title: VascuSR: Iterative Anatomy-Aware Diffusion for CT Super-Resolution
items.summary: VascuSR is an iterative diffusion framework that integrates 3D vascular guidance with super-resolution to improve anatomical accuracy and vascular connectivity in CT reconstructions.

items.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
items.summary: A framework for self-evolving agent harnesses uses feedback-driven revisions and evolutionary optimization with theoretical generalization guarantees while keeping model weights fixed.

items.title: CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
items.summary: CarryOn enhances frozen vision-language-action policies with persistent personalized planning and supervised execution with recovery skills to improve safety and adaptability.

items.title: RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment
items.summary: Vision-language models struggle to convert 2D visual observations into precise 3D rotational control, showing large gaps versus humans in projection alignment tasks.

items.title: Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents
items.summary: SpecAgent improves agent efficiency by having a small model draft tool-use steps that a large model verifies in parallel, reducing latency and memory use while preserving quality.
